record.question: An Executive Engineer sells a piece of land he owns to a private contractor who has frequent official dealings with his department. He reports the transaction after the sale is complete, stating there was no need for prior approval. Which of the following statements is correct?
options: He has committed no violation if the sale is reported within one month
Violation- prior sanction was required because the buyer has official dealings
Violation- sale of immovable property is completely prohibited
No violation if transaction value is below 25,000
